name: Access Communication Concepts
summary: Sydney dialup + hosting ISP + IT consulting under COMMUNICATION CONCEPTS PTY LTD (ACN 002 954 458, an early-1980s registration; ABN active from Jun 2001); accc.net.au first archived Aug 2000, ISP era ended ~2004.

events.details: Dialup, hosting, IT/network consulting. Website accc.net.au first archived 15 Aug 2000 (this is the first web presence, not an incorporation date). The operating company COMMUNICATION CONCEPTS PTY LTD (ACN 002 954 458) is an early-1980s registration; its ABN is active only from 1 Jun 2001 — so the ISP brand's web launch is best dated ~2000.
source: ABR: COMMUNICATION CONCEPTS PTY LTD, ABN 45 002 954 458 - https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=45002954458

refs.label: Still advertising ADSL/Broadband connectivity in Dec 2010.
By Feb 2011 site had become a hosting/web company with no connectivity products.
